newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil June car output up 37.83 pct - Anfavea.
newsitem.headline: Brazil June car output up 37.83 pct - Anfavea.

text.p: Brazil produced 188,539 vehicles in June, up 37.83 percent over the same month last year, Brazil's Motor Manufacturers Association (Anfavea) said.
Production last month also rose 3.28 percent from May, when 182,557 vehicles were produced, an Anfavea spokesman said.
In the first six months of the year, Brazil produced 1,025,875 vehicles, up 23.63 percent over the same period last year, he said.

Last month, automakers sold 152,786 vehicles in Brazil, 36.76 percent more than the 111,717 vehicles sold in June 1996. Last month's sales rose 4.09 when compared to the previous month, when 146,789 vehicles were sold in the domestic market, he said.
Brazil vehicle exports rose 27.74 percent to 33,265 vehicles last month from 26,042 vehicles in June 1996, he added.
